title: Conditions for a chosen stretch of water
description: Wind, swell and tides next to the time and place of the forecast.

blocks.text: Someone on the water needs to compare several conditions that a general weather card shows separately.

quote.text: I’m a fishing charter captain in Ocean Isle Beach, NC and I use the Windy app daily for planning trips. Super simple, reliable, and accurate.

blocks.text: Save the stretch of water and the interval, and compare the available parameters with observations from the spot. Show the age and the units for each.
A summary like this helps make sense of the data and is not a guarantee of a safe outing.
